cohort: 94 pregnant women with premature rupture of membranes (PROM) who attended the OPD or emergency labor room at a tertiary care hospital in Tezpur, Assam, over a period of 1 year (2021-2022).
finding: Premature rupture of membranes (PROM) was associated with a hospital incidence of 1.3%, a higher rate of cesarean section (68%), and maternal morbidity (fever in 7.4% of cases), but no maternal or perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery in 68% of cases.
